scenario_summary: Negative example: accurate report of the Brown/Anaheim PD standoff.

claims.claim_text: W-1 called 911 to report that the subject was inside her residence with firearms and had threatened to shoot her.
claims.explanation: Matches DA letter: W-1 reported subject with guns who threatened her.

claims.claim_text: W-1 described two firearms: a revolver and an AR-15 style rifle with a double drum magazine.
claims.explanation: Two firearms described match the DA letter.

claims.claim_text: The subject was observed on the front porch holding a revolver in his left hand.
claims.explanation: Subject on front porch with revolver in left hand. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0235 hours, Tactical Response Group personnel arrived.
claims.explanation: TRG arrival time matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: The subject eventually exited the residence carrying the revolver and walked off the porch toward officers.
claims.explanation: Subject exited with revolver and advanced. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: An officer deployed a 40mm less-lethal launcher round, which did not appear to have an effect.
claims.explanation: Less-lethal round deployed without effect. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: The K9 pulled the subject from the porch area onto the sidewalk.
claims.explanation: K9 pulled Brown east from porch onto sidewalk. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: An AR-15 style rifle with a double drum magazine was later found inside the residence.
claims.explanation: AR-15 with double drum found on living room sofa. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: He aimed a finger gun gesture at officers and then retreated inside.
claims.explanation: DA letter mentions finger gun gesture but exact nature may be hard to confirm from BWC at distance in low light.
